opportunities.name: Resistance weave duelist
opportunities.objective: Invest in the resistance ratios while weaving mark-consuming attacks.
opportunities.mechanic: Ntofo Strikes has 0.4 armor and 0.4 MR statFormula expressions despite physical damage; Path Maker also links percent-health damage to defenses. Iceborn delivers a separate physical Spellblade slow after Q, Jak'Sho raises bonus defenses after five seconds, and Visage supports E's received shield. All Out removes 85% bonus defenses, so the outside-R payoff must be measured separately.
opportunities.requiredState: Need marks consumed by actual attacks and combat lasting until Jak'Sho's bonus applies.
opportunities.failure: All Out makes the defense snapshot uncertain; late shield or W charge can miss the window.
opportunities.test: Compare Q/W and mark damage before R, immediately after R and after Jak'Sho activation.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Resistance scaling does not establish AP scaling or permanent full-defense damage during All Out.

opportunities.name: Ally dash shield escort
opportunities.objective: Use Footwork's ally shield and control to protect one carry.
opportunities.mechanic: Footwork grants a shield with a 0.135 health-stat expression and extends dash range when targeted at an ally, shielding both. Knight's Vow and Locket support that escort pattern, Frozen Heart discourages nearby attacks, and Bandlepipes rewards Q/W control with an ally attack-speed aura. R can separate a threat but risks trading away K'Sante's defensive stats.
opportunities.requiredState: Need a reachable ally, E available and controlled R usage after protecting the carry.
opportunities.failure: Peeling with R can strand the carry; enemy range bypasses the close aura and Vow tether.
opportunities.test: Measure carry damage prevented, E shield size and time K'Sante remains within aura range.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Health-stat formula flags are not proof that E scales from all total health in the displayed amount.

ruledOut.idea: AD health conversion as primary Q scaling
ruledOut.reason: Primary Q lists defense expressions rather than an AD ratio; Bloodmail does not directly improve that term.

unknowns: Passive max-health token is unresolved; resistance snapshot behavior in All Out and current alternate W wrappers require testing.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: All Out makes the defense snapshot uncertain; late shield or W charge can miss the window.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Resistance scaling does not establish AP scaling or permanent full-defense damage during All Out.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Iceborn Gauntlet, Jak'Sho, The Protean, Unending Despair, Spirit Visage, Thornmail, Mercury's Treads. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

kitEvidence.formula:
K'Sante shatters his ntofos to Knock Back an enemy champion, dealing [80 / 115 / 150] physical damage, then dashes behind them and goes All Out for [15]s. If the enemy would hit a wall, they are Knocked Back through the wall and K'Sante strikes them again for [80 / 115 / 150 + (0.05) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]] physical damage.

While All Out, K'Sante's Abilities are upgraded and he gains [(0.4 / 0.6 / 0.8) × 100]% Attack Speed, [50]% Bonus Armor Penetration, and [20]% Omnivamp, but loses [35]% max Health, [85]% Bonus Armor, and [85]% Bonus Magic Resistance.

K'Sante's damaging Abilities mark enemies hit. Attacking a marked enemy deals [12] plus [UNRESOLVED({ee18a47b}; see calculationRaw)] max Health physical damage and consumes the mark.

All Out: K'Sante's Attacks, Abilities and Passive deal an additional [0.01 + (0.0001) × Stat(1)[statFormula=2] + (0.0001) × Stat(6)[statFormula=2]] max Health physical damage.

K'Sante dashes, gaining [70 / 112.5 / 155 / 197.5 / 240 + (0.135) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]] Shield for [2] seconds. If dashing to an ally, the distance of the dash is significantly increased and the ally is also Shielded.

All Out: Cooldown is decreased by [50]% and dash speed is increased.

K'Sante raises his weapons defensively for [0.4]-@MaxDuration.1@s, becoming Unstoppable and reducing incoming damage by [25]%. Then, he rams forward, dealing [45 / 75 / 105 / 135 / 165] + [0.08 + (0.0002) × Stat(1)[statFormula=2] + (0.0002) × Stat(6)[statFormula=2]] max Health physical damage. Enemies hit are Knocked Back and Stunned for [0.5]-[1.75]s (based on charge time).

All Out: Cooldown is refreshed. Deals an additional [10]-[80]% damage as true damage (based on charge time), damage reduction is increased to [70]% and dash speed is increased, but no longer Knocks Back or Stuns.

K'Sante slams his weapon, dealing [70 / 100 / 130 / 160 / 190 + (0.4) × Stat(1)[statFormula=2] + (0.4) × Stat(6)[statFormula=2]] physical damage and Slowing enemies by [80]% for [0.5]s. If he hits, he gains a stack of Ntofo Strikes for [6] seconds. At 2 stacks, he instead fires a shockwave that Stuns and Pulls enemies for [1] second.

All Out: Cooldown is reduced by @RCooldownReduction.0*100@%.
